about.seo_title: About LEEKAV | Appliances & Home Essentials in Kenya
about.seo_description: Discover LEEKAV: appliances, electronics and home essentials from Kärcher, Midea and LG, with clear product information and delivery across Kenya.
about.body:
Good brands. Thoughtful choices.

LEEKAV brings appliances, electronics and home essentials together in one place, helping you choose products that fit your home and your everyday needs. Explore brands including Kärcher, Midea and LG, from cleaning equipment and kitchen appliances to laundry care and home entertainment.

Find the right fit for your home

A useful purchase starts with clear information. Compare prices, specifications and availability, and check the warranty details and downloadable manuals provided on individual product pages. If you are unsure about capacity, dimensions or the right product for a particular task, send our team a product enquiry before ordering.

A simpler shopping experience

  • Browse by brand or category, or search by product name and SKU.
  • Save favourites and revisit them from your customer account.
  • See the available delivery rate and final order total before placing an order.
  • Follow order, payment and delivery updates in your account.
  • Read approved reviews from customers and share your own experience after a delivered purchase.

Here to help

We serve customers across Kenya through our configured county delivery options. For help choosing a product, checking an order or requesting after-sales assistance, contact the LEEKAV team.

contact.seo_description: Contact LEEKAV for product advice, delivery enquiries, order tracking, returns and warranty assistance. Include your order reference for faster identification.
contact.body:
How can we help?

Use the enquiry form or the contact options above for product advice, delivery questions and help with an existing order.

Before placing an order

Share the product name or SKU and tell us what you need help with, such as size, capacity, specifications, warranty information or delivery to your county.

Help with an order

Include your order reference, the email address used at checkout and a brief description of the issue. You can also check the latest status in your account.

Keep your information safe

Do not send passwords, payment PINs, one-time codes or full card details through the enquiry form. For returns, describe the problem and keep any supporting photos and packaging available for review.

faq.seo_title: LEEKAV FAQ | Orders, Delivery, Payments & Returns
faq.seo_description: Answers to common questions about shopping at LEEKAV, Kenyan delivery options, payment methods, order tracking, returns and verified product reviews.
faq.body:
Shopping & products

How do I find a product?

Use Shop by category, Shop by brand or the search bar. Search accepts product names and SKUs. Filters on listing pages help narrow your selection by category, brand, price, availability and specifications.

Where can I find specifications and warranty details?

Open the product page for specifications, available warranty information and any downloadable manual or brochure. If a detail is missing, contact us before ordering.

Can I order without an account?

Yes, guest checkout is available. Keep your order confirmation and tracking link. A customer account lets you view your order history, manage saved addresses and favourites, and access eligible return and review actions.

Delivery & payment

Which counties do you deliver to?

Delivery options currently cover all 47 Kenyan counties. Select your county at checkout to see the available option and charge. Read our Shipping & Returns information for further guidance.

How much does delivery cost?

The standard configured delivery charge is KES 500. Free delivery may apply where the selected zone has a qualifying order threshold. Your final delivery charge is shown when you review the order at checkout.

How can I pay?

Checkout shows the payment methods currently enabled for the store, including Cash on Delivery when available. Follow the instructions for the selected method. Only use a payment option shown at checkout or confirmed through the store's contact channels.

How do I know the final amount?

Review your order before placing it. The summary shows the items, applicable discounts, VAT information, delivery charge and total in KES.

After ordering

How do I track my order?

Sign in, open the Orders tab and select an order to view its order, payment and delivery statuses. The normal delivery flow is Pending, Confirmed, Dispatched and Delivered.

Can I cancel an order?

Eligible orders display a cancellation action in their details. If it is not available, contact us with your order reference so we can review your request.

How do I request a return?

Open an eligible delivered and paid order in your account, expand Request a return, and provide the reason and requested refund amount. Submission starts a review; it does not automatically approve a return or issue a refund.

Who can leave a product review?

Customers with a delivered or completed purchase of the product can submit one review and edit it later. Reviews can include a star rating, text and optional photos. Only approved reviews appear publicly; edits are checked again before publication.

Still need help?

Contact us with your product name, SKU or order reference.

shipping-returns.seo_title: LEEKAV Shipping & Returns | Delivery Across Kenya
shipping-returns.seo_description: Learn how LEEKAV county delivery rates, free-delivery thresholds, order tracking, return requests and refunds work before placing your order.
shipping-returns.body:
Delivery across Kenya

LEEKAV currently offers delivery options across all 47 Kenyan counties. At checkout, select Kenya, choose your county and select the available delivery option. Enter a complete street address, building or landmark, and a phone number that can be used to coordinate delivery.

Delivery charges

The standard configured charge is KES 500 per order. The selected delivery zone determines whether a free-delivery threshold applies. Currently, free delivery is configured for Nairobi orders from KES 50,000, Kiambu orders from KES 75,000 and Mombasa orders from KES 100,000. Review the final checkout summary to confirm the charge for your order.

Delivery arrangements & tracking

Delivery arrangements depend on product availability, your location and the order's processing stage. Contact us if you need a delivery estimate before ordering. A delivery date is not guaranteed merely by submitting an order.

Your order details show its latest status: Pending, Confirmed, Dispatched, Delivered or Cancelled. Any available tracking reference is shown there. Keep your phone number and delivery directions accurate, and contact us promptly if they need to change.

Returns & product issues

If an item is damaged, incorrect or appears faulty, contact us with your order reference and a description of the issue. Keep the item, accessories, packaging and supporting photos available so the team can assess the request and explain the next steps.

Submitting a request

For an eligible delivered and paid order, sign in to your account, open the order and expand Request a return. Provide a clear reason and the requested refund amount. If the account action is unavailable, use the contact form for assistance.

Submitting a request does not authorise collection, approve a return or issue a refund. Wait for instructions before sending an item back. Eligibility and the appropriate resolution depend on the issue, the product's condition, its warranty terms and applicable consumer rights.

Review & refunds

The team reviews the request, may ask for further information, and updates its status in your account. Where a refund is approved, the amount and payment arrangements are confirmed as part of that process. Refunds are not issued automatically when you submit a request.

Warranty support

Warranty coverage differs between products. Refer to the product page and any supplied warranty documentation, and contact us for help with a claim. This information does not limit your rights under applicable Kenyan consumer law.

privacy.seo_title: LEEKAV Privacy Notice | Customer Information & Choices
privacy.seo_description: How LEEKAV uses customer contact details, account and order information, enquiries, reviews and newsletter subscriptions, and how to request privacy assistance.
privacy.body:
Last updated: 7 October 2026

Information we collect

When you browse, create an account, place an order or contact LEEKAV, we may receive information needed to provide the service. This includes your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, account information, order and payment references, enquiry messages, return requests and product reviews or photos you choose to submit.

Newsletter subscriptions collect the email address you provide. Shopping bag and wishlist preferences may be saved in your browser or customer account.

How we use information

  • Manage customer accounts, orders and delivery arrangements.
  • Record payment activity and assist with reconciliation, returns and refunds.
  • Respond to enquiries and provide order or service updates.
  • Moderate customer reviews and display approved review content.
  • Send optional newsletter communications to subscribed addresses.
  • Protect accounts, investigate misuse and meet applicable record-keeping obligations.

Reviews and photos

Approved reviews can publicly display the reviewer's name, rating, review text, submission date, verified-purchase badge and any submitted photos. Do not include personal contact details, payment information or other people's private information in a review or photo. Edited reviews are checked again before publication.

Service providers & disclosure

Relevant information may be shared with delivery, payment, email, hosting or other service providers where needed to fulfil an order or operate the service. Information may also be disclosed where required by law or necessary to address fraud or a dispute. If a service provider processes information outside Kenya, applicable data-protection requirements and safeguards must be considered.

Cookies & browser storage

Account sessions use cookies to keep you signed in. Browser storage is used for shopping bag and guest wishlist selections. Clearing this data may sign you out or remove saved selections. Where analytics or marketing integrations are enabled, they may collect browsing information; their use is subject to the applicable privacy and consent requirements.

Security & retention

Account passwords are stored as hashes rather than readable passwords, and access to administrative information is restricted by role. Keep your login details private and do not send passwords or payment PINs in an enquiry.

Information is retained for the purposes described here and for applicable legal, accounting, fraud-prevention or dispute requirements. A deletion request may not remove records that must be retained for those purposes.

Your choices & rights

You can update your profile and saved addresses in your account. Contact us to request access to your personal information, correction of inaccurate details, deletion where applicable, or to object to relevant processing or withdraw consent. You may also contact us to stop newsletter communications. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

Kenyan data-protection rights and their applicable conditions are explained by the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner, which also provides a route for privacy complaints.

Privacy enquiries

Use the Contact page and describe your request without including passwords or sensitive payment details. We may update this notice when the service or relevant requirements change.

terms-conditions.seo_title: LEEKAV Terms & Conditions | Shopping, Orders & Payments
terms-conditions.seo_description: Read LEEKAV shopping terms covering product information, checkout, order processing, delivery, returns, customer accounts and product reviews.
terms-conditions.body:
Last updated: 7 October 2026

Shopping with LEEKAV

These terms explain how to use the LEEKAV storefront and place orders. Read the product information, checkout summary, Shipping & Returns information and Privacy Notice before completing a purchase. If something is unclear, contact us before ordering.

Product information

Check the selected product, model or SKU, specifications, dimensions, colour, availability and warranty information. Some images are representative of the product type rather than the exact model; contact us if the appearance or a particular feature is essential to your purchase. Warranty details and manuals are provided where available and may differ by product.

Prices & checkout

Prices and order totals are displayed in Kenyan shillings (KES). The checkout review shows the item subtotal, applicable discounts, VAT information, delivery charge and final total. Coupon eligibility, restrictions and validity are checked when applied. Review these details and your contact and delivery information before placing the order.

Orders & payment

Submitting an order creates a record for processing and tracking. Order status and payment status are separate: an order confirmation or order reference does not by itself establish that payment has been received or that delivery has been completed.

Use a payment method offered at checkout and follow its instructions. For Cash on Delivery, payment collection is arranged in connection with delivery. If there is a problem with stock, product information, payment or delivery arrangements, the team may contact you to resolve it or explain the available next steps.

Delivery & cancellations

Delivery is provided through enabled Kenyan county zones, at the charge shown in the checkout review. Give accurate delivery directions and contact details. Any delivery estimate is subject to the arrangements confirmed for the order.

Eligible orders show a cancellation action in the customer account. Where that action is unavailable, contact us promptly with the order reference. A cancellation enquiry does not mean a dispatched order has already been cancelled.

Returns & warranty issues

Return requests are reviewed rather than automatically approved. Follow the process in Shipping & Returns and wait for instructions before sending back an item. Warranty claims depend on the applicable product documentation. Nothing in these terms is intended to exclude rights or remedies available under applicable Kenyan consumer law.

Customer accounts & reviews

Keep account details accurate and protect your password. Do not misuse the service, interfere with other accounts or submit misleading information.

Reviews require a delivered or completed purchase of the product. One review is allowed per customer and product, with editing available. Only approved content is published. Submit your own relevant experience and photos you are entitled to share; do not include unlawful, abusive or private information.

Questions & updates

Contact the team through the Contact page for questions or issues involving an order. These terms may be updated; the displayed update date identifies the current version. Relevant Kenyan law applies, including the protections available to consumers.
